description: Development on seen data: quality-aware candidates for relating Sentinel-2 NDCI to EA lab chlorophyll, against the lab chlorophyll test's baseline, on held-out lakes, seasons and years. Not a chlorophyll measurement, not shown on the site, and not an algae, toxin or safety estimate.
source: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2021-2026. Sentinel-2 L2A via Earth Search; the lab chlorophyll test's scene-classification cache and cores; EA Water Quality Archive chlorophyll (determinand 7887, acetone extract, spectrophotometric, phaeopigment correction not stated), Open Government Licence v3.0.

candidates.B0: baseline: nearest usable scene within a day, core median NDCI, the test's linear calibration
candidates.A: the same, low-signal readings excluded (contract 1.4's rule)
candidates.B: every reading kept, weighted by its measured signal (fitted variance model, inverse-variance blend)
candidates.C: brightness and pixel spread as covariates, with a reading-by-brightness interaction
candidates.D: dark pixels dropped before the median (floor chosen inside each training fold)
candidates.E: composite: median of quality-passing scenes within 3 days

partial.note: The fetch ended on a second dropped connection (section 3), so results rest on the scenes read; amendment 2 labels them partial.

E.reason: No scene other than a sample's paired scene was read (the fetch ended at 183 of the 207 paired scenes), so every composite is the paired scene's unmarked reading and E's figures are A's.

lakes_most_helped.lake: Martham Broad or Martham Broad (North and South)

words: A (the same, low-signal readings excluded (contract 1.4's rule)): held-out lakes, paired samples, skill +0.306 against the baseline's +0.163, gain +0.143 [+0.005, +0.306], coverage 81%; supported for a shadow log (conditions met on the paired samples).

B (every reading kept, weighted by its measured signal (fitted variance model, inverse-variance blend)): held-out lakes, paired samples, skill +0.180 against the baseline's +0.163, gain +0.017 [-0.066, +0.139], coverage 100%; not supported: fails condition 1 (gain +0.017, lower end -0.066; needs +0.03 and above -0.05).

C (brightness and pixel spread as covariates, with a reading-by-brightness interaction): held-out lakes, paired samples, skill +0.300 against the baseline's +0.163, gain +0.137 [+0.034, +0.233], coverage 100%; supported for a shadow log (conditions met on the paired samples).

D (dark pixels dropped before the median (floor chosen inside each training fold)): held-out lakes, paired samples, skill +0.197 against the baseline's +0.163, gain +0.034 [-0.122, +0.178], coverage 93%; not supported: fails condition 1 (gain +0.034, lower end -0.122; needs +0.03 and above -0.05).

E (composite: median of quality-passing scenes within 3 days): not tested. No scene other than a sample's paired scene was read (the fetch ended at 183 of the 207 paired scenes), so every composite is the paired scene's unmarked reading and E's figures are A's.
Shadow log: the baseline and A, C, from frozen coefficients, beside each new reading.

All of this is development on seen 2021-2026 pairs; the fresh check is pairs made after contract 1.4. Nothing here is a claim about algae, toxins or whether water is safe, or a chlorophyll measurement.
